mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the presence of a declining FEDFUNDS trend are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 320, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST above 1250) signal strong consumer demand for durable goods, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250 during late-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 6 months indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO trend fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it reflects economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5 over a 5-day horizon, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1250) and retail sales (RSAFS > 700000) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined condition of HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 700000 fails to yield positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive central bank policy that increases discount rates for equities, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 during tightening cycles, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.
